output.headline: Sub-sector strategics like Evolent Health and platform-backed sponsors like Blackstone are the buyers for this Health IT target; the comparable median is the defensible price.
sentences: Call Evolent Health first (3 deals in the sub-sector, closed $325M), then Blackstone; order among the sponsors is close to a tie, with back-tests at 28% versus 20% random [E:tier1, E:sponsor_ordering]
The defensible price is the median of 13 comparable deals, 21.4x EBITDA; Blackstone, Francisco Partners and Evolent can pay it comfortably, and a sponsor can go to $356M [E:valuation, E:tier1, E:lbo]

The review removed Ciox Health and Cerner, now inside Datavant and Oracle, and folded Change Healthcare into UnitedHealth Group; sponsors without a distinct angle sit in the second list [E:review, E:tier2]
The motive most buyers share is diversification and technology capability, present in 100% of 50 Health IT deals, with high growth close behind at 90% [E:motives]
